```{r barnes_maze_data_loading}
# Empty global environment

### 1. File path
getwd()

# From group 4, cohort 1

# group 4, cohort 2
my.data.d5.42 <- read.csv(coh_42_d5, header=T, skip=1, dec = ",")

#my.data.d5.42$gr <- "42"

my.data.d5.42 <- my.data.d5.42[-3,]
my.data.d5.42 <- my.data.d5.42[-3,]

my.data.d5.42 <- my.data.d5.42[-7,]
#my.data.d5.42$Esc..Lat...s. <- as.numeric(my.data.d5.42$Esc..Lat...s.)
#my.data.d5.42 <- my.data.d5.42 %>%

my.data.d12.42 <- read.csv(coh_42_d12, header=T, skip=1, dec = ",")

my.data.bm$test <- factor(my.data.bm$test, levels = c("day5","day12"), labels = c("D5","D12")) # order the days non-alphabetically

my.data.bm <- my.data.bm %>% 
  mutate(perc.correct = (`C..holes` *100)/`A..holes`)

my.data.bm <- my.data.bm[-38,]
my.data.bm <- my.data.bm[-21,]
```

```{r barnes_maze_data_loading_lat}

### 1. File path
file_path_lat <- "~/AOCF-Behavioral Tests/Barnes Maze test/control data/group data/data_lat/"

### 2. Load data file (all cohort, both d5 and d12)
rdata_lat1 <- "Barnes Maze test_gr1_2024-11-15.xlsx"
rdata_lat2 <- "Barnes Maze test_gr2_2024-11-15.xlsx"
rdata_lat4 <- "Barnes Maze test_gr4_2024-11-15.xlsx"

# Read data file
data_lat1 <- read_excel(paste(file_path_lat,rdata_lat1,sep=""))

data_lat1 <- data_lat1 %>%
  # Select relevant columns
  dplyr::select(No., Animal, gr, Day, `Duration (s) Zone_goal_area`, `Duration (s) Zone_Left_of_goal_area`, `Duration (s) Zone_opposite_goal_area`, `Duration (s) Zone_right_of_goal_area`) %>%
  mutate(time_total = as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_goal_area`)) + as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_Left_of_goal_area`)) + as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_opposite_goal_area`)) + as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_right_of_goal_area`))) %>%
  mutate(perc_right = as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_right_of_goal_area`))*100/time_total,
         perc_left = as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_Left_of_goal_area`))*100/time_total,
         perc_opp = as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_opposite_goal_area`))*100/time_total,
         perc_goal = as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_goal_area`))*100/time_total)

# Read data file
data_lat2 <- read_excel(paste(file_path_lat,rdata_lat2,sep=""))

data_lat2 <- data_lat2 %>%
  # Select relevant columns
  dplyr::select(No., Animal, gr, Day, `Duration (s) Zone_goal_area`, `Duration (s) Zone_Left_of_goal_area`, `Duration (s) Zone_opposite_goal_area`, `Duration (s) Zone_right_of_goal_area`) %>%
  mutate(time_total = as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_goal_area`)) + as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_Left_of_goal_area`)) + as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_opposite_goal_area`)) + as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_right_of_goal_area`))) %>%
  mutate(perc_right = as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_right_of_goal_area`))*100/time_total,
         perc_left = as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_Left_of_goal_area`))*100/time_total,
         perc_opp = as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_opposite_goal_area`))*100/time_total,
         perc_goal = as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_goal_area`))*100/time_total)

# Read data file
data_lat4 <- read_excel(paste(file_path_lat,rdata_lat4,sep=""))

data_lat4 <- data_lat4 %>%
  # Select relevant columns
  dplyr::select(No., Animal, gr, Day, `Duration (s) Zone_goal_zone`, `Duration (s) Zone_left_of_goal_zone`, `Duration (s) Zone_opposite_goal_zone`, `Duration (s) Zone_right_of_goal_zone`) %>%
  mutate(time_total = as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_goal_zone`)) + as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_left_of_goal_zone`)) + as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_opposite_goal_zone`)) + as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_right_of_goal_zone`))) %>%
  mutate(perc_right = as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_right_of_goal_zone`))*100/time_total,
         perc_left = as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_left_of_goal_zone`))*100/time_total,
         perc_opp = as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_opposite_goal_zone`))*100/time_total,
         perc_goal = as.numeric(sub(",", ".", `Duration (s) Zone_goal_zone`))*100/time_total)

data_lat4$Day <- str_replace(data_lat4$Day, "D14", "D12")

colnames(data_lat4)[which(colnames(data_lat4) %in% c("Duration (s) Zone_goal_zone", "Duration (s) Zone_left_of_goal_zone", "Duration (s) Zone_opposite_goal_zone", "Duration (s) Zone_right_of_goal_zone"))] <- c("Duration (s) Zone_goal_area","Duration (s) Zone_Left_of_goal_area","Duration (s) Zone_opposite_goal_area","Duration (s) Zone_right_of_goal_area")

# subset data with only animals present in my.data.bm
a1 <- my.data.bm %>%
  filter(gr == 1) 
a1a <- unique(a1$Animal)

data_lat1$Animal <- as.numeric(data_lat1$Animal)
data_lat1s <- subset(data_lat1, Animal %in% a1a)

a2 <- my.data.bm %>%
  filter(gr == 2) 
a2a <- unique(a2$Animal)

data_lat2$Animal <- as.numeric(data_lat2$Animal)
data_lat2s <- subset(data_lat2, Animal %in% a2a)

a4 <- my.data.bm %>%
  filter(gr == 4) 
a4a <- unique(a4$Animal)

data_lat4$Animal <- as.numeric(data_lat4$Animal)
data_lat4s <- subset(data_lat4, Animal %in% a4a)

# concatenate to create one df
data_lat <- bind_rows(data_lat1s,data_lat2s,data_lat4s)
data_lat$Day <- as.factor(data_lat$Day)

# add gender column 
data_lat <- data_lat %>% 
  mutate(sex = case_when(
    Animal == 214 ~ "m",

    Animal == 435 ~ "f",
    Animal == 439 ~ "f",
    Animal == 445 ~ "m",
    Animal == 460 ~ "f",
    Animal == 11 ~ "f",
```

__Statistics for Figure 1 A__

```{r BM_path_length_coh1_stat, echo=F}

#create a tibble to collect all stats
stats = tibble()

## d5 between genotypes
datafig1d5 <- pl.length1$data %>%
  filter(test == "D5") %>%
  #convert sex and grs into factors 
  mutate(sex=factor(sex, levels = c("m", "f")),   
         gr=factor(gr, levels = c(1, 2, 4)))

# perform Kruskal-Wallis Rank Sum Tests to compare between genotype difference
#st <- tidy(kruskal.test (`Length [cm]`~ genotype, data=datafig1d5)) %>%
#  mutate(method = "Kruskal-Wallis Sum",

# perform Pairwise Wilcoxon Rank Sum Tests to compare between group difference
 st = tidy(pairwise.wilcox.test(datafig1d5$Length..cm., datafig1d5$gr, exact = FALSE, p.adjust.methods="BH")) %>%
    mutate(method = "Pairwise Wilcoxon Sum",
           variable = "Fig 1, d5, path length (cm)",
           test = paste("between grs"), 
           sign = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""))
 
#combine stats from every iteration of the loop
stats = bind_rows(stats, st)
  
## d14 between genotypes
datafig1d14 <- pl.length1$data %>%
  filter(test == "D12") %>%
  #convert sex and grs into factors 
  mutate(sex=factor(sex, levels = c("m", "f")),   
         gr=factor(gr, levels = c(1, 2, 4)))

# perform Kruskal-Wallis Rank Sum Tests to compare between genotype difference
#st <- tidy(kruskal.test (`Length [cm]`~ genotype, data=datafig1d5)) %>%
#  mutate(method = "Kruskal-Wallis Sum",

# perform Pairwise Wilcoxon Rank Sum Tests to compare between group difference
 st = tidy(pairwise.wilcox.test(datafig1d14$Length..cm., datafig1d14$gr, exact = FALSE, p.adjust.methods="BH")) %>%
    mutate(method = "Pairwise Wilcoxon Sum",
           variable = "Fig 1, d12, path length (cm)",
           test = paste("between grs"), 
           sign = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""))

#combine stats from every iteration of the loop
stats = bind_rows(stats, st)

#format the table
stats%>%
  #remove horizontal lines between rows
  kable(booktabs = T) %>%
  #prevent table from floating and scale it to page-width
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position","scale_down"))
  
#st_tracklength = stats

```

__Statistics for Figure 1 B (Between genders)__

```{r BM_path_length_coh1g_stat1, echo=F}

# BETWEEN GENDERS WITHIN SAME GENOTYPE

# get list of cohorts
list_of_genders <- c("f", "m")
list_of_genders <- as.factor(list_of_genders)

# get list of genotypes
list_of_grs <- c(1, 2) #because only females in  gr4

#create a tibble to collect all stats
stats = tibble()

## d5 within genotype
datafig1ad5 <- pl.length1g$data %>%
  filter(test == "D5") %>%
  #convert sex and grs into factors 
  mutate(sex=factor(sex, levels = c("m", "f")),   
         gr=factor(gr, levels = c(1, 2, 4)))

for (i in 1:length(list_of_grs)) {
  stat_data <- datafig1ad5 %>%
    filter(gr == list_of_grs[i])
# perform Wilcoxon Rank Sum Tests to compare between group difference   datafig1d5$Length..cm.
  st = tidy(wilcox.test(stat_data$Length..cm. ~ stat_data$sex, exact = FALSE)) %>%
   mutate(method = "Wilcoxon Sum",
          variable = "Fig 1, d5, path length (cm)",
          test = paste("between genders for group", list_of_grs[i]), 
          sign = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""))
 
#combine stats from every iteration of the loop
stats = bind_rows(stats, st)
}

## d14 within genotype
datafig1ad14 <- pl.length1g$data %>%
  filter(test == "D12") %>%
  #convert sex and grs into factors 
  mutate(sex=factor(sex, levels = c("m", "f")),   
         gr=factor(gr, levels = c(1, 2, 4))) 

for (i in 1:length(list_of_grs)) {
  stat_data <- datafig1ad14 %>%
    filter(gr == list_of_grs[i])
# perform Wilcoxon Rank Sum Tests to compare between group difference
  st = tidy(wilcox.test(stat_data$Length..cm. ~ stat_data$sex, exact = FALSE)) %>%
   mutate(method = "Wilcoxon Sum",
```
